- Provides comprehensive coaching for indie developers and small teams launching mobile apps on iOS and Google Play.

- Includes deep diagnostics to assess readiness and guide next steps based on user profile, stack, monetization, regulatory needs, and constraints.
- Offers actionable advice for common questions, from App Store rejection to ASO ranking and paywall design.
- Triggers on a wide range of relevant topics like native vs cross-platform, in-app purchases, privacy labeling, and user acquisition strategies.
